# NMAFC

> Biologically-inspired stateful memory for LLM agents: bounded, high-signal
> memory with exponential decay, spaced repetition (LTP), override suppression
> and an append-only archive for rollback. Python 3.11+, local-first, ten LLM
> routes and five embedding routes, S3/PostgreSQL remote backends. Licence:
> PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (non-commercial use free, commercial requires
> agreement).

## Install & quickstart

- [Installation](docs/installation.md): pip/uv, extras matrix (`llm`, `anthropic`, `aws`, `postgres`, `fastembed`, `web`, `mcp`, `cli`, `all`), Python 3.11–3.13.
- [Quickstart walkthrough](docs/quickstart.md): three constructors, remember/recall, process_turn, context managers, tenancy, maintenance.
- Minimal sync usage:

```python
from nmafc import SyncNeuromorphicMemory

with SyncNeuromorphicMemory.from_openai() as mem:   # needs OPENAI_API_KEY
    stored = mem.remember([{"role": "user", "content": "I'm allergic to shellfish."}])
    print(stored.updates_ingested)                   # facts written
    hits = mem.recall("what can't I eat?")
    print(hits.context)                              # bounded memory context
```

## Public API map

- [API reference](docs/api.md): every exported symbol; import from `nmafc` root.
- Classes: `NeuromorphicMemory` (async: `process_turn`, `remember`, `recall`, `forget_entity`, `forget_record`, `ingest_updates`, `consolidate`, `rollback`, `get_*_stats`, `get_events*`, `maintain`, `close`), `SyncNeuromorphicMemory` (same, blocking; `*_sync` variants; `from_providers`).
- Constructors (both classes): `from_openai()` (key-only), `from_env()` (env vars decide), `from_config(config=…|config_path=…)`.
- Result types: `RememberResult` (`turn`, `updates_ingested`, `overrides_suppressed`, `consolidated`, scope ids), `RecallResult` (`query`, `context`, `hits`, `token_estimate`, `turn`, scope ids).
- Config: `NMafcConfig` (`llm_provider_model`, `embedding_provider_model`, `agent_id`, `conversation_id`, `storage`, `decay`).
- Exceptions: `NmafcError` base; `MissingAPIKeyError`, `MissingExtraError`, `ProviderNotConfiguredError`, `StorageError`.
- `__all__` is the stability contract; everything else may change in any release.

## Configuration precedence

- Explicit argument > environment variable > TOML file > library default.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): every env var (`NMAFC_LLM_PROVIDER_MODEL`, `NMAFC_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER_MODEL`, `NMAFC_EMBEDDING_DIM`, `NMAFC_AGENT_ID`, `NMAFC_CONVERSATION_ID`, `NMAFC_DATA_DIR`, `NMAFC_HOT_URI`, `NMAFC_COLD_URI`, `NMAFC_EVENT_LOG_URI`, `NMAFC_LLM_TEMPERATURE`, `NMAFC_LLM_MAX_TOKENS`).
- Decay/consolidation constants are frozen — configure models and locations, not cognition.

## Providers

- [Providers](docs/providers.md): LLM routes `openai/`, `anthropic/`, `azure/`, `azure_v1/`, `bedrock/`, `groq/`, `openrouter/`, `together/`, `ollama/`, `lmstudio/`, `vllm/`; embeddings `openai/`, `azure/`, `bedrock/`, `ollama/`, `fastembed/`.
- Provider prefix selects the route from a `"provider/model"` string; bare `"model"` means `openai/model`.
- Key env vars: `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GROQ_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `TOGETHER_API_KEY`, `AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY` (+ `AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT` for Azure), AWS chain for `bedrock/`; none for local routes.

## Storage

- [Storage](docs/storage.md): data dir (`NMAFC_DATA_DIR`; macOS Application Support / XDG data home / `%APPDATA%`), per-store URIs, S3 hot with `storage_options`, PostgreSQL cold, multi-tenancy, layout recipes.
- Hot tier: LanceDB, local or `s3://`. Cold tier: SQLite local or `postgresql://`. Event log: local SQLite only (documented limitation).
- Multi-tenant scoping: every record keyed by `(agent_id, conversation_id)`.

## Errors

- [Error catalogue](docs/errors.md): trigger, example message, and fix for every public exception.
- `MissingAPIKeyError` names the env var; `MissingExtraError` names the `pip install nmafc[extra]` command; `ProviderNotConfiguredError` names the missing setting; `StorageError` names the credential chain or path.
- Catch `NmafcError` for all of them. Empty `remember`/`recall` results are not errors.
